_comment: Audit item #27 CI security scanning. Each entry documents a pip-audit finding with no available fix, reviewed and accepted with a dated reason. Every other finding fails the gate.

allowed.reason: Path-traversal read (CVE-2026-12243) in nltk.data.load()/find() when called with an attacker-controlled resource name; no fix version exists upstream yet. nltk is a transitive dependency of rouge-score (dev-only summarization-quality test metric) — civiccast/ never imports nltk, and no runtime or CI path calls nltk.data.load()/find() with any input, let alone untrusted input. No fix version available as of this review; re-check when nltk publishes one.
